title: Higher bounded Hochschild cohomology of von Neumann algebras
exact_target: For every complex von Neumann algebra M and every integer $k\geq 2$, is each bounded k-cocycle with coefficients in M a bounded coboundary, that is $H^k(M,M)=0$, without a complete-boundedness or separability restriction?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.

manuscripts.title: Vanishing of higher bounded Hochschild cohomology
